answer: Histories are stored in umber, checked in lantern, and beacon shows each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 19 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 648 identities would post 1189 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
